text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Having left something behind, I stopped by the dance studio—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This choreography is pretty tricky.
It looks subtle, but it's tough... Whew.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh. It's you, Trainer.
Didn't notice you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Nice Nature was practicing so hard
was the choreography for dancing on the side.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah, I guess so.
Looks like I'll be in this position pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Then wouldn't it be better to focus our practice on this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her slightly lonely words,
I struggled with how to respond—
choice_data_list: Suggest practicing for the center position

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how surprising.
...I thought you'd be against it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature has her own pace.
Rather than rushing her, I want to stay close to her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I don't want to deny her potential.
That's why—
choice_data_list: Instead, let's make it a dance that'll mesmerize everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...
...There you go again.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Thanks a bunch.
choice_data_list: If you want, why don't we dance together!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, forget about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her words sounded exasperated,
her expression had softened ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Center practice, huh...
Well, that's what they say, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has what it takes to finish first,
and more than anything, I didn't want her to give up from the start.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...
...Oh, really.
choice_data_list: So let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, fine, fine.
I'll do it, alright?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Starting now, I don't know how much we can polish it up, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: When you put it so definitively, well...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's nothing at all~!
